title: Elephant wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="32" ry="24" fill="#9AA7B8"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="26" y="85" width="12" height="12" rx="4" fill="#7E8CA0"/>
  <rect x="62" y="85" width="12" height="12" rx="4" fill="#7E8CA0"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="26" fill="#B0BEC9"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="40" rx="14" ry="20" fill="#8FA1B3"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="40" rx="14" ry="20" fill="#8FA1B3"/>
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="40" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#C7D3DC"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="40" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#C7D3DC"/>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d="M50 56 Q48 72 44 80 Q40 88 48 90 Q56 92 54 82 Q52 74 54 62" fill="#A8B8C6" stroke="#C7D3DC" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x="28" y="34" width="18" height="12" rx="4" fill="#2E3A59"/>
  <rect x="54" y="34" width="18" height="12" rx="4" fill="#2E3A59"/>
  <rect x="46" y="37" width="8" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#3E4E73"/>
  <rect x="24" y="36" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#3E4E73"/>
  <rect x="70" y="36" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#3E4E73"/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x="31" y="37" width="4" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#6FA8DC"/>
  <rect x="57" y="37" width="4" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#6FA8DC"/>
  <!-- tusks -->
  <path d="M38 58 Q36 66 40 68" fill="none" stroke="#F0F4F8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 58 Q64 66 60 68" fill="none" stroke="#F0F4F8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
